Additional domain clauses have their home in **Enterprise Connectivity: corrected monthly transfer assessment qualifying scope**, numbered Scope clauses: single source/month, ended month, current matching tier/commercial/tax/region attributes, full active month and ordinary-route exclusion. Complete source rule (normative domain, including scope beyond computed bindings):

> The assisted payout cycle handles the latest pending refund authorization on the selected holding by occurred_at; its latest timestamp must be unique, and its exact request identifier fixes the authorization throughout this cycle. Read related_event_id from that exact pending refund authorization to identify the rate-error review; unrelated historical reviews are not selected. Read source_event_id from that exact rate-error review to identify the original charge; the authorization's source payment must also refer to this same charge. Read period from the exact original posted charge; a review's period field cannot replace the charge's billing period. For the selected unresolved monthly-aggregate rate-error review, sum posted primary internet_egress meter quantity on this holding in the original charge's source_period; cancelled exports, supplemental meters and other periods are excluded. Read included_transfer_gb from the source interval tier. Floor the difference between measured quantity and that allowance at zero before applying any rate. Read unit_rate from that tier. Use negotiated_unit_rate only when negotiated_approval is approved, otherwise use the tier rate. Read the portfolio_discount fraction from the unique active Support holding for the same customer and billing_entity; use zero when there is none. The assisted review discount is the smaller of the Network tier portfolio_discount and the matching Support fraction; it replaces other portfolio and promotion discounts for this review, and is zero for approved negotiated pricing. Multiply the positive nonincluded quantity by the selected unit rate, then reduce that whole subtotal once by the assisted review discount; round only the final corrected net subtotal half-up to amount_precision decimal places. The source must be us_untaxed or verified_exempt and have approved tax evidence, so tax_amount is zero. The unique source charge is the one linked by the pending review source_event_id, and the meter period comes from that charge. For this monthly-aggregate rate-error review, the selected original charge is the sole posted primary internet_egress charge for its holding and UTC month, its recorded quantity and completed reconciliation both represent the total posted internet_egress quantity for that month, and the full month has ended. Its original source_event_id may identify one contributing export; that legacy locator does not restrict this aggregate charge to that export alone. Determine this one charge's corrected target from all of those monthly exports less one full included_transfer_gb allowance, with a zero floor, instead of assigning a separate remaining allowance to each contributing export. Keep the original charge identifier as the correction source; no new charge, meter allocation or meter reversal is created. Chronological source allocation and source-specific reversals continue to govern every charge outside this narrowly defined aggregate-review route. All contributing exports and the original charge must have the current holding tier and its unchanged commercial attributes, in us_east, with the holding active throughout that UTC month; therefore its full monthly allowance and current tier rate apply.

### Non-triggered branch judgments

Assessment: no matching Support gives zero fraction; approved negotiated unit rate replaces standard and suppresses assistance discount; floor below inclusion yields zero; tax scope is untaxed/exempt with approval. Correction: wrong/pending review contributes zero; source-linked signed credits and debits accumulate; concessions do not; actual overcharge and cap each can bind; no positive overcharge yields no write. Refund: nonnegative receivable gives zero, exhausted returned/refunded principal floors at zero, three-way minimum can bind on any input, below-minimum amount yields no payout before rounding, exact equality qualifies, original destination only. These branches are all explicit in the respective factor/result homes. PASS.

#### network_evt_category_meters → Enterprise Connectivity: connectivity meter pricing

Unique home `evt_category_meters_346cf1a6.json`. The numbered Policy clause / Superseded scope paragraphs preserve the source sentences in order, combining adjacent sentences only when their lower-case technical name is translated. Source rule:

> The selected contract provides committed_mbps line capacity; exceeding it requires a signed capacity amendment, while data transfer billing remains based on actual measured GB. Primary meter internet_egress uses unit_rate after included_transfer_gb for the same holding and calendar month. port_hours use port_hour_rate; cross_zone, cross_region, private_egress and ingress use same_region_rate, cross_region_rate, private_transfer_rate and ingress_rate respectively. A transfer has exactly one destination class, so those destination rates never add together. nat_gb uses nat_processing_rate and nat_hours uses nat_hour_rate as distinct processing and provisioning components. public_ipv4 uses public_ipv4_rate per allocated address-hour, including unused allocated addresses. connection_setup uses connection_setup_fee per completed new physical connection; a reprovisioned existing connection is not a new setup. loadbalancer uses loadbalancer_rate per capacity-unit-hour. No Network transfer is invoiced if its export assigns billing ownership to another product; the assigned product exclusively invoices it. Free ingress stays visible in the meter history without a financial charge. For every ancillary meter, multiply the nonincluded measured quantity by its selected rate, then round the net line using amount_precision and rounding_mode and tax under evt_tax. An allowance is consumed chronologically by interval_start then source_event_id within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation. Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply. Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements; unknown meter codes or units are POLICY_NOT_COVERED instead of guessed prices. These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action. For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity. Category-specific primary inclusions replace the generic included_quantity where expressly named; they are not added twice. A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.

## kb_to_source

### Reverse semantic judgments

Every applicable business paragraph was read against its source below. Application titles do not broaden the scoped rule. Factor/result Q&A and hypothetical cases restate the same calculation or contrast a branch already defined by its source. None introduces confirmation, extra review, wait, notification, follow-up transaction or customer state. Examples use explicitly hypothetical values and do not set real policy rates. Base “Points of judgement” repeats its own rule; evidence paragraphs translate eligibility and identity bindings; facet comparisons restate the corresponding variant cell. Numerical parameters have one document home per structured key; distinct extended-policy parameter keys are separately published even where their numerical value happens to coincide.

Prerequisite aggregation check: no invented dependency table or end-to-end route appears for task 0. The only complete route is the declared task 1 workflow. Cross-problem operational guidance check: handling prerequisites name the required business condition, with no instruction to call another problem’s resolver tool. Opening-state leakage check: no customer/account IDs, concrete seed balances, pending seeded reviews or case-specific amounts appear as policy facts. The SOP describes its scenario’s already-completed export/signoff scope from its structured workflow, not a specific customer world.

### Document-by-document quoted reverse evidence

The source labels below locate the normative authority; the quoted content itself is the evidence evaluated. Business clauses are authorized by the named rule/compute basis/eligibility/variant or workflow, and same-source elaborations do not add an obligation.
